hypothesis: Jointly optimize all native poses on the same fixed model and ranges as forward control. Compare quarter/unit dimensionless weights on derivative of model-minus-input unit-direction error. No raw speed or Euler-coordinate smoothing. Test original-model feasibility before any additional domain changes.
selection: Same conditions for all records; no reference motion, reference lengths or IDs enter fitting. Preserve pre-trajectory seed and optimized coordinates. Objective improvement only permits a candidate; independent R scoring decides accuracy.
parameter_basis: 5deg/5cm/10deg-per-second are existing engineering scales; .25 and1 are prospective objective-weight ablations, not physiological constants; max20 evaluations is a compute cap recorded with convergence diagnostics.
preregistration: Five fixed development combinations x three conditions =15.000 is a passing regression control. Existing23 and original656 unchanged.
